# Security Policy

## Scope

This policy is the default for MOGSEC repositories that do not define a repository-specific security policy. Security review and remediation focus on actively maintained code on the default branch. Consult a repository's own policy for any additional supported releases.

## Private Vulnerability Reporting

Report suspected vulnerabilities to [contact@mogsec.com](mailto:contact@mogsec.com) with the subject `Security disclosure`. Do not disclose vulnerabilities through public issues, pull requests, or discussions.

Include only the information necessary to assess the report:

* Affected repository, component, and revision.
* Potential impact and required conditions.
* Minimal, non-destructive reproduction steps and sanitized evidence.
* Suggested mitigation, if known.

Do not include credentials, access tokens, personal identifiers, or client data. Request a secure transfer method before sharing sensitive technical evidence.

## Responsible Validation & Coordinated Disclosure

Test only systems you own or have explicit authorization to assess. Avoid service disruption, destructive changes, persistence, or access to data beyond what is necessary to demonstrate the issue. Stop testing if sensitive data is encountered and report the condition privately.

MOGSEC will assess reports, coordinate remediation, and agree on disclosure timing with the reporter. Keep vulnerability details private until remediation and coordinated disclosure are complete.
